findings.title: Complete old E1 includes a coupling counterterm and a previous Gaussian normalization
findings.finding: The activity calculation does not explicitly budget -beta1(g0) A in E1. The old log Z^(0)(U1(V(x))) is variable-dependent, unlike the current normalization outside the integral. Source (1.6)-(1.7) permits including that old log Z in the aggregated activity family.
findings.minimal_repair: Specify aggregated E^(1), add +g1^2 beta1(g0) Hess_x A to the negative-log-density Hessian, and include B_beta C_A in the constant. Keep 1/g0^2 = 1/g1^2 + beta1(g0).
findings.impact: Incomplete full-density proof as written, not a counterexample to the desired estimate or its g1^2 scaling.

findings.title: Source cutoff excludes selected bonds
source_anchors: CMP109 p267 selected h support and induced selected-bond bounds
findings.finding: The literal all-reconstructed-bond cutoff in 1496 is not (2.9). Since h is supported on selected bonds and C is identity on free bonds, the actual cutoff is the product of |g1 a_b| < epsilon1 over free bonds.
findings.minimal_repair: Write the exact free-bond product. Identify convex bond norm factors rather than assume scalar rectangles. Do not add equal-radius selected-bond constraints.
findings.impact: Repairs rather than defeats the required product geometry.

findings.title: P1 current norm follows through the Landau identity
findings.finding: Equation (190) lists D*D and Laplacian derivative bounds, not P1 separately. The fixed-background Landau identity P1 H = Delta H - D*D H + lower-order local terms provides the missing operator link.
findings.minimal_repair: Write this identity and keep the reference external background fixed when taking input derivatives. Preserve a common uniform complex domain for all composed maps.
findings.impact: A source-supported bridge is available; an arbitrary projection or real-only decay would not suffice.

findings.title: Fixed odd L must be source-admissible
findings.finding: The source fixes odd L > 11 and imposes its other regularity, M, kappa and coupling requirements. Fixed odd L alone does not state those restrictions.
findings.minimal_repair: Use fixed source-admissible L and retain the exact source model/parameter class.
findings.impact: No extension to all odd L, arbitrary dimensions/groups or arbitrary regularity classes established.

findings.finding: Uniform complex first-derivative kernels plus a common input radius give the minimum/max-distance bounds by Cauchy and symmetry. The star loss is summable. The two-term activity Hessian and rooted entropy comparison avoid a volume multiplier.
